prompt:
Island Transport Academy — sunny Taiwan coastal picture-book, premium preschool game art for ages 3–8. Rounded hand-painted gouache shapes with subtle paper texture, confident midnight-blue contours, toy-like proportions, warm sunlight. Palette sea blue #1479B8, ink #143B61, vivid orange #F46B27, signal yellow #FFD344, leaf green #58B85B. Cheerful clean composition, readable large silhouettes, no generic dark teal UI, no photorealism, no watermark.
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE geometrically continuous wide coastal road panorama for a scrolling preschool driving game. Landscape 2048x1024. Reference 1 defines the same sunny Taiwanese lighthouse, banyan village, blue-white curbs and paved parking bay; reference 2 defines the connected main road. IMPORTANT composition: no split panels, no duplicate lighthouse, no cross-fade, no ghosting. The SAME wide tan asphalt road occupies the entire lower 45% continuously from left to right. The LEFT HALF (x0-50%) is an entirely clear main roadway curving into the distance on the left, with absolutely NO parking sign or parking rectangle anywhere in this half. The RIGHT HALF is a generous open asphalt lay-by that joins the main road smoothly through a wide uncurbed opening at x55%, with one complete white parking rectangle entirely within x65%-88%, y65%-90%, and a blue P sign entirely within x93%-98%, y48%-60%. The two sides connect directly without any curb crossing the path between x25% and x75% at y75%. No curbs or plants in the lower central horizontal driving corridor. The camera is slightly elevated behind an imagined small car (do not draw the car), with strong readable road perspective. Ocean, distant mountains, one lighthouse at x20%, small orange-roof house at x65% and banyan shade far right. This is a finished single painted scene; there must be NO OVERLAID SCENES and NO PEOPLE, no cars, no UI, no arrows, no numbers except the P parking sign. Preserve the exact coastal picture-book style and palette of both reference images. Background opaque.
